title: EDI Middleware & AS2 Gateway
description: Built an asynchronous X12 EDI pipeline connecting retail partners and warehouses to Icicle ERP, from ingestion and validation through mapping, acknowledgements and audit trails.
highlights: Implemented signed and encrypted AS2 transport with synchronous and asynchronous MDN receipts.
Added idempotent document ingestion, tenant configuration and append-only audit records.
Integrated swappable ERP adapters and containerized API, worker and database services.

title: TGA-Mesh
tagline: Workforce operations and payroll integration for childcare centres
description: Built a NestJS workforce backend covering rostering, leave, timesheets, Xero payroll synchronization, messaging and staff engagement across childcare centres.
highlights: Implemented shift and leave rules with worker-based timesheet aggregation.
Integrated queued Xero payroll sync, encrypted credentials and retry handling.
Delivered Socket.IO messaging, Firebase notifications and an S3 document library.

title: FashionTryOn
description: Designed a virtual fitting room platform and Shopify integration that separates the commerce lifecycle from AI providers. This project is in active development / production proof of concept.
highlights: Unified Gemini, ComfyUI and Decart/FASHN generation pipelines behind a provider adapter interface.
Designed queued generation with callbacks so GPU workloads do not block storefront requests.
Built modular integration boundaries for future commerce platform adapters.

title: StenGen
role: Lead Backend & Computer Vision Systems Engineer
description: Engineered an image processing and vectorization pipeline that turns photographs and artwork into stencil-ready tattoo outlines, with a NestJS gateway and Python processing workers.
highlights: Separated ingestion, validation and user sessions from image-processing workloads.
Combined OpenCV image quantization and vector processing for stencil-oriented output.
Built asynchronous boundaries between the API gateway and image worker layer.
